messages:
mia_sales: Quick check — Delta trial cutover readiness. SE asked for certs and timelines, flag blockers? cc @sam_solutions @noah_platform @olivia_security

sam_solutions: Delta needs SAML cert + IP allowlist by Tue 2024-04-09. Planning load tests week of 2024-04-15. Any infra constraints?

noah_platform: Staging dedicated pool maintenance 2024-04-16 00:00–06:00 UTC. We can provision burst capacity earlier but cost delta. @mia_sales can you ask Delta to prep certs earlier?

anya_ml: Model team needs initial prompt set + gold evals by 2024-04-12 to validate generation. If late, model validation moves into canary and adds ~48h.

olivia_security: Security checklist: SOC2 access review + IPsec config. We can fast-track on NDA; have Delta send legal contact to delta@redwood.legal

sam_solutions: Recap actions:
1) Delta -> SAML cert + allowlist by 2024-04-09
2) SE -> prompt set + evals by 2024-04-12
3) Infra -> reserve burst capacity + cost estimate (INF-4321)
4) Security -> start SOC2/access review on NDA receipt
Any objections?

noah_platform: ACK. Opening INF-4321, cc eng-oncall. Reservation ETA 24h after ticket.

mia_sales: Pinging Delta now and updating trial doc: https://redwood.internal/pocs/delta-trial (acceptance: p50 <200ms, 99.9% availability in test window, model accuracy drop <2%)

sam_solutions: Quick code review ping — PR #289 in se-integ (retry/backoff logic) needs review. @noah_platform can you take it?

noah_platform: Will review by EOD. Suggest exponential backoff vs fixed. Will add PR comment.

olivia_security: If customer-managed keys used, we'll need key rotation policy + HSM/KMS mapping doc.

mia_sales: Scheduling 30-min async sync Thu 2024-04-11 10:00 PT if live alignment needed.

deploy-bot: Reminder — maintenance window 2024-04-16 00:00–06:00 UTC. Infra deploys in that slot, incidents channel for issues.

sam_solutions: Fallback: if Delta can't meet 04-09, use sandbox creds on 04-10 and block prod traffic until certs present.

mia_sales: I'll escalate if Delta misses 04-12. Thanks everyone.
